svg.title: Pumpkin wallet finishing order
svg.desc: Embroider the face on the front half, fold right side out between stitches 10 and 11, seam both short edges, sew the leaf tab inside the back rim, mark the snap with a card inside, then stand the rolled stem on the tab base.
svg.text: Order that keeps the stem on the back rim
Leave rows 10 to 13, stitches 1 to 5 empty
Right side out. Pair 10 with 11 through 1 with 20
3. Whipstitch both short edges, then test a card
4. Tab inside the back rim, snap marked with a card
Ball on tab row 6. Socket through the front layer
5. Roll the 6-stitch width, not the short end
Stand that short cylinder on the tab base
